set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
DeviceScene keeps no frames, so a host that draws a compiled Plot or Scene cannot map a data position to device coordinates or back. Hand-built scenes with a known viewport are the only workaround. Picking, tooltips at data positions, host-drawn overlays and synchronized cursors all need this. Verified at 2fa5c68.

Scope
Each named viewport or panel of a compiled scene exposes its resolved device frame (device rectangle plus native-to-device mapping per axis, including scale transforms). There is an invertible mapping from device to native coordinates, with a typed error outside the frame or for non-invertible scales. The API is pure (core), is used by picking, and is available to every backend.

Acceptance criteria
1. For each geom in the conformance scene, a mark's native position maps to its lowered device position within a stated tolerance, and the inverse maps back.
2. Scale transforms (log, reverse) are handled or explicitly refused with a typed error.
3. Facets and composed plots expose one frame per panel, addressable by panel identity.
4. Frames are cross-built (JVM and JS) and documented.
set.title: [Intaglio] Expose resolved viewport frames and their inverse mapping on compiled scenes
